text_block_list.text:
While walking with Meisho Doto,
someone spoke to us in a whisper...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Pardon me for calling out to you out of the blue!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I found your wallet, Doto-san...!
Please just take it without asking any questions!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees.
I'm right over hereee~...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, but... u-ugh...
Touching an Umamusume is guilty—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, just breathing the same air right now
is making my heart beat out of my chest...!!

After calming down a frantic Agnes Digital,
I managed to retrieve the wallet...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You really saved me by bringing this.
Hawww~~, thank you so muchhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-And so—if... if it's all right with you, I'd... I'd really like to repay you somehow...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyeek!? I-I couldn't possibly accept! Your kind words alone are more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
J-J-Just that alone wouldn't feel right!
Would it... not be okay~~...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa—!? Wait, that's so cute...!
I want to frame it and gaze at it for the rest of my lifeee!!

"We won't make any progress at this rate...
I should propose a reward
that Agnes Digital would be thrilled about."
choice_data_list: How about a photo together as my thank-you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's allowed!?
Is th-th-that really okay... !?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh... A photo...!
I-I'll... try my bestttt...!

The photoshoot began after changing locations, but...
Meisho Doto is stiff as a board with nerves.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawa, hawawawawa...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nhaaa! Isn't that bashful expression insane!? A goddess has descended! Cuteness overload right here~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueee~~h!?
C-Cu-Cute, cuuuute~~~???

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at that bashful face!
I'm fully aware I'm not hiding my excitement at all...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-Do I look flustered...!?
Th-This is so embarrassing~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fweh...!? I-I'll give it a tryyy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ouch...? M-Mmhmm...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ababababa! Doto-san desperately trying to smile
is just so precious... so, so precious~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, huh? Whuh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, I can't smillleee!?
W-W-What should I dooo!?"
choice_data_list: Let's picture a smile in your mind!
Wanna go for a little run?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Howa... U-Understood!
Umm... Um, well~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ha, hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa?! C-Could that be...
an impression of Opera O-san?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right...!
I know it's a bit presumptuous, but it left the strongest impression on meee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!
Bwahahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, am I... smiling properly...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So precious... So easy to stan...
Wait, I'm already stanning her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha... *cough*, *cough* *hack*?!

Choking between fits of laughter, Meisho Doto somehow
managed to get through the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, yes, ma'am!
I'll run and relax my body!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's heeeeeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...I ran waaaay too much.
*pant*... *gasp*... I've hit my limit..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whoa, my legs are getting tangled... ;?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyowaaaaaaaah~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry~~!
I didn't mean to glomp you... F-Forgive me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha-wha-what! This is taboo!
You mustn't, th-th-that's out of the question!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhi, ah, no!
I shouldn't, but I can't stop smiling~~âªâª

"A fine composition. ...Just to be safe,
I took a photo of the two of them together."
